core_obligations: The author organizes iterated graded multiplication/comultiplication with permuted tensor factors into nonnegative matrices with prescribed row and column sums, keeping the tensor-order permutation explicit. This gives the general noncocommutative Solomon-Mackey composition law and the corresponding PNSym action, where internal product encodes composition and external product encodes convolution. The full PNSym construction and rigorous compatibility appendix supply the source-local algebraic core; cocommutative/classical reductions and identity-checking applications are context, not extra counts.
